event_chain.summary: Theft of trade secret booklet from hearing room

summary: During a lunch break at a Georgia Public Service Commission regulatory hearing in October 2025, Patty Durand, a former PSC candidate and outspoken critic of Georgia Power, allegedly picked up a booklet labelled 'Georgia Power Trade Secrets' from a desk, put it in her purse and left the room. She was captured on video, returned the booklet the same day, and was arrested by Georgia Capitol Police on a felony theft-of-trade-secrets charge. In January 2026 the Fulton County DA declined to prosecute, noting Georgia Power confirmed no actual financial harm.
